description.value: The Shipyards Skate Plaza is a covered outdoor ice rink operated by the City of North Vancouver, situated in the vibrant Shipyards waterfront district on the North Shore of Burrard Inlet. Part of a larger public space that includes Shipbuilders' Square and a splash park, it draws visitors to one of North Vancouver's most animated gathering spots. It operates seasonally, so touring cyclists would encounter it as a landmark waterfront destination rather than a year-round attraction.
